title: Frontend Design System Migration
description: Next.js workspace with semantic design tokens, reusable primitives (forms, feedback, overlay), a live component playground, and Storybook + Vitest quality gates—including CI—so consuming apps can migrate away from one-off UI drift.

title: POS & Inventory Management System
description: Archive Room — live consignment POS on Vercel + Neon for clothing shops: tablet checkout, multi-tenant inventory, reporting, and platform ops. Deployed and in continuous development/support.

title: FLASHCUT

title: Realtime Operations Dashboard
description: Realtime operations dashboard with WebSocket event streams, service health tiles, alert states, and reconnect/stale-data UX — demo e-commerce platform monitoring with a self-contained event simulator.

title: RC Crawler PH — Builder & Community
description: Parked product bet: MN82 1:12 rig builder in PHP (presets, shareable builds, community pricing) plus PH crawler community — gallery, spots, events, clubs. Desktop 3D rig viewer started; accurate per-part models and production deploy still open.
impact: PH budget build planning in pesos

title: Document Keeper
description: Roadmap: a documentation keeper that indexes and renders markdown across personal projects — release plans, roadmaps, runbooks, and specs — with search and links back to source repos (Archive Room, CMS, design system).

title: Developer Productivity Portal
description: Ship desk that centralizes CI status, release notes, and service health — with acknowledge/publish actions, an activity trail, fixture Harbor Commerce data, and optional GitHub Actions/Releases sync.

title: Mobile Delivery Companion
description: DropRoute — Expo field companion with offline-first stop updates, SQLite outbox sync/retry, and explicit local-vs-dispatch conflict resolution for a Manila morning route.

title: AI-Assisted Incident Triage UI
description: AI-assisted incident triage console with Gemini (or rule-based) severity/category suggestions, seeded runbooks, human override, and an audit trail — free-tier Next.js + Prisma portfolio demo.

title: Portfolio CMS + Publishing Workflow
description: Built a dedicated CMS with draft preview and PR-based publishing for portfolio content. Added role-aware workflows, validation, and release guardrails, significantly reducing content update turnaround with auditable change history.
